title: Terraform Cloud API token
whyItMatters: terraform login saves the HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise API token in plain text in this file. The token can change infrastructure and read state for every workspace the account can reach.
source: Terraform docs, terraform login: the token is saved in credentials.tfrc.json in the CLI configuration directory, ~/.terraform.d on macOS - https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/login
notes: A credentials helper or TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE can move or replace this storage. The token list is in the HCP Terraform user settings.

cleanup.signOut: Revoke the API token in the HCP Terraform user settings under Tokens, so the token copied from this Mac stops working.
steps: Revoke the token in the HCP Terraform user settings.
Delete the file named in the plan using Finder.
Check the organization audit log for runs you do not recognise.
cleanup.risk: Removes the saved Terraform login from this Mac. A token that is not revoked keeps working until it is deleted.
cleanup.source: HashiCorp, Terraform CLI configuration file credentials: https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/config/config-file
